title: Enterprise CRM - Sales Pipeline & Performance System
shortSummary: Designed and delivered a custom CRM that centralized pipeline tracking and performance reporting into one operational workflow.
outcome: Centralized pipeline and performance reviews into one live dashboard used for weekly decision cycles.
problem: Sales pipeline updates and performance reporting lived across disconnected files, causing slow reviews and unclear ownership.
constraints: Had to fit active sales operations with minimal disruption
Needed role-based access for contributors and managers
Deployment target required Docker + Nginx with predictable recovery
approach: Mapped sales stages and reporting logic before schema design
Built backend services in Laravel with PostgreSQL for pipeline events and rollups
Implemented the operator UI in Next.js with focused workflows for data entry and reviews
Containerized stack with Docker and Nginx for stable deployment handoff
results: Created one source of truth for pipeline movement and performance snapshots
Reduced manual reconciliation during weekly check-ins
Delivered a modular base ready for future sales ops features
